machine_extruder_start_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;V-BLADE
;TOOL PRE-SCRIPT Tool 1 Start
T1
M83; Extuder Relative
M900 K{material_linear_advance_factor}; K comp
M420 L1 ; Topo comp enable for new head
M109 S{material_print_temperature} T1; T1 to Temp
M106 S{cool_fan_speed}; Fan On
M83; Extuder Relative
;TOOL PRE-SCRIPT Tool 1 End
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

machine_extruder_end_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;TOOL POST-SCRIPT Tool 1 Start
M83; Extuder Relative
M104 S{material_standby_temperature} T1; Setting idle temp
G27 P0 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T1; Park position to purge
M106 S0 ; Purging Fan Speed
G4 S{mold_width}; Wait before purge to allow fan to stop
G1 E{material_flush_purge_length} F{material_flush_purge_speed} ; Purge T1
M106 S{material_surface_energy} ; Purging Cooling Fan Speed
; 'material_surface_energy' variable is being used as a stand-in variable for fan speed while cooling purge
G1 E-5 F1800 ; Retract to help ooze from swap
G4 S{mold_angle}; Wait before wiping for nozzle to cool and have less ooze after wipe
G12 T1; Wiping idle purge
M106 S0
G27 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 S1 T1; Park position to purge
M83; Extuder Relative
;TOOL POST-SCRIPT Tool 1 End
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
